description: Systems and applications do not have automatic lockout mechanisms configured for mobile devices, workstations, or sessions after a period of inactivity. This signal indicates that unattended devices and sessions remain accessible, creating opportunities for unauthorized access.
applicability: This signal applies to: Workstation and desktop systems Mobile devices (phones, tablets) Server console sessions Web application sessions Remote desktop sessions Kiosk systems Physical access terminals

metadata.detection_notes: Review CIS compliance documentation and controls for CONFIG requirements.

sources.title: CIS Controls v8
sources.section: Control 4: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
